name: Kim Min-jun
action: Min-jun tells Mr. Park he'll come to the community center on Saturday for badminton, saying, "Sure, I'll be there."
reason: Min-jun first hesitated, mentally calculating the two hours against his application block and budget deadlines, though a flicker of desire for adult conversation nudged him toward accepting. On reflection, he weighed the outing differently: his best job lead came from casual playground contact, not from his formal applications, and the community center event was free and casual—not a drain on his job search but a possible source of useful contact. The memory of the hiking club he quit warned him not to turn badminton into a forced networking task, so he resolved to treat it as play. This reflection strengthened his inclination to accept, overriding his benchmark-driven worry about losing control of two unlogged hours for a single weekend. He still felt the pull of discipline and the sting of his father's Saturday calls, but he chose to accept the invitation, keeping the time in view without letting it unravel his routine.
